```{r}
# merge counts files
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(data.table)
})

# ============================================================
# 1. Input files
# ============================================================

# Keep the analysis date fixed so today's result remains reproducible later.
analysis_date <- as.Date("2026-08-19")
analysis_seed <- as.integer(format(analysis_date, "%Y%m%d"))
set.seed(analysis_seed)
message(
    "[INFO] Analysis date: ", analysis_date,
    "; random seed: ", analysis_seed
)

base_dir <- "/path/to/F5_AdarSG"

file_WBg <- file.path(base_dir, "WBG_STAR_featureCounts_new")
file_AdarG <- file.path(base_dir, "AG_STAR_featureCounts_new")
file_AdarS <- file.path(base_dir, "AS_STAR_featureCounts_new")

# Output
out_file <- file.path(
    base_dir,
    "WBg_AdarG_AdarS_featureCounts_raw_merged.tsv"
)

# ============================================================
# 2. Desired sample order
# ============================================================

sampleNames <- c(
    "WBg_F1", "WBg_F2", "WBg_F3",
    "WBg_M1", "WBg_M2", "WBg_M3",
    "AdarG_F1", "AdarG_F2", "AdarG_F3",
    "AdarG_M1", "AdarG_M2", "AdarG_M3",
    "AdarS_F1", "AdarS_F2", "AdarS_F3",
    "AdarS_M1", "AdarS_M2", "AdarS_M3"
)

sample_WBg <- sampleNames[1:6]
sample_AdarG <- sampleNames[7:12]
sample_AdarS <- sampleNames[13:18]

# featureCounts annotation columns
info_cols <- c(
    "Geneid",
    "Chr",
    "Start",
    "End",
    "Strand",
    "Length"
)

# ============================================================
# 3. Function: read one featureCounts file
# ============================================================

read_featurecounts <- function(file, sample_names) {
    cat("[INFO] Reading:", file, "\n")

    if (!file.exists(file)) {
        stop("Input file does not exist: ", file)
    }

    # skip featureCounts comment/header command line
    dt <- fread(
        file,
        skip = "Geneid",
        header = TRUE,
        sep = "\t",
        check.names = FALSE
    )

    cat(
        "[INFO] Rows:", nrow(dt),
        " Columns:", ncol(dt), "\n"
    )

    # Check basic structure
    missing_info <- setdiff(info_cols, names(dt))

    if (length(missing_info) > 0) {
        stop(
            "Missing annotation columns in ", file, ": ",
            paste(missing_info, collapse = ", ")
        )
    }

    count_cols <- setdiff(names(dt), info_cols)

    if (length(count_cols) != length(sample_names)) {
        stop(
            "Expected ", length(sample_names),
            " sample columns in ", file,
            ", but found ", length(count_cols),
            "\nDetected count columns:\n",
            paste(count_cols, collapse = "\n")
        )
    }

    # Rename BAM-path columns directly by their positions
    setnames(
        dt,
        old = count_cols,
        new = sample_names
    )

    # Check duplicate genes
    if (anyDuplicated(dt$Geneid)) {
        dup <- unique(dt$Geneid[duplicated(dt$Geneid)])
        stop(
            "Duplicated Geneid detected in ", file,
            ". Example: ", paste(head(dup, 10), collapse = ", ")
        )
    }

    return(dt)
}

# ============================================================
# 4. Read three genotypes
# ============================================================

WBg <- read_featurecounts(
    file_WBg,
    sample_WBg
)

AdarG <- read_featurecounts(
    file_AdarG,
    sample_AdarG
)

AdarS <- read_featurecounts(
    file_AdarS,
    sample_AdarS
)

# ============================================================
# 5. Check gene sets
# ============================================================

cat("\n[INFO] Gene number:\n")
cat("  WBg   :", nrow(WBg), "\n")
cat("  AdarG :", nrow(AdarG), "\n")
cat("  AdarS :", nrow(AdarS), "\n")

genes_all <- Reduce(
    union,
    list(WBg$Geneid, AdarG$Geneid, AdarS$Geneid)
)

genes_common <- Reduce(
    intersect,
    list(WBg$Geneid, AdarG$Geneid, AdarS$Geneid)
)

cat("  Union :", length(genes_all), "\n")
cat("  Common:", length(genes_common), "\n")

if (
    length(genes_all) != nrow(WBg) ||
        length(genes_all) != nrow(AdarG) ||
        length(genes_all) != nrow(AdarS)
) {
    stop(
        "Gene sets are not identical among WBg / AdarG / AdarS.\n",
        "Please check whether all three files were generated using the same GTF."
    )
}

# ============================================================
# 6. Use WBg gene annotation as reference
# ============================================================

gene_info <- WBg[, ..info_cols]

# Match other genotype tables to WBg Geneid order
idx_AdarG <- match(gene_info$Geneid, AdarG$Geneid)
idx_AdarS <- match(gene_info$Geneid, AdarS$Geneid)

if (anyNA(idx_AdarG) || anyNA(idx_AdarS)) {
    stop("Failed to match Geneid among the three featureCounts files.")
}

AdarG <- AdarG[idx_AdarG]
AdarS <- AdarS[idx_AdarS]

# ============================================================
# 7. Check annotation consistency
# ============================================================

check_annotation <- function(ref, query, name) {
    for (cc in info_cols) {
        x <- as.character(ref[[cc]])
        y <- as.character(query[[cc]])

        bad <- which(
            !(is.na(x) & is.na(y)) &
                (is.na(x) | is.na(y) | x != y)
        )

        if (length(bad) > 0) {
            warning(
                "Annotation column '", cc,
                "' differs between WBg and ", name,
                " for ", length(bad), " genes."
            )
        }
    }
}

check_annotation(WBg, AdarG, "AdarG")
check_annotation(WBg, AdarS, "AdarS")

# ============================================================
# 8. Combine counts
# ============================================================

count_WBg <- WBg[, ..sample_WBg]
count_AdarG <- AdarG[, ..sample_AdarG]
count_AdarS <- AdarS[, ..sample_AdarS]

merged <- cbind(
    gene_info,
    count_WBg,
    count_AdarG,
    count_AdarS
)

# Force exact final column order
final_cols <- c(info_cols, sampleNames)

setcolorder(
    merged,
    final_cols
)

# ============================================================
# 9. Sanity checks
# ============================================================

stopifnot(
    identical(names(merged)[1:6], info_cols)
)

stopifnot(
    identical(names(merged)[7:24], sampleNames)
)

cat("\n[INFO] Final table:\n")
cat("  genes   :", nrow(merged), "\n")
cat("  columns :", ncol(merged), "\n")

cat("\n[INFO] Sample order:\n")
cat(
    paste(
        sprintf("%2d. %s", seq_along(sampleNames), sampleNames),
        collapse = "\n"
    ),
    "\n"
)

# ============================================================
# 10. Write output
# ============================================================

fwrite(
    merged,
    file = out_file,
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    na = "NA"
)

cat("\n[DONE] Output written to:\n")
cat(out_file, "\n")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Figure 5 core functions
# DESeq2 LRT + VST + DEGreport::degPatterns
# ============================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(DESeq2)
    library(DEGreport)
    library(data.table)
    library(dplyr)
    library(tidyr)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(tibble)
    library(clusterProfiler)
    library(org.Dm.eg.db)
    library(AnnotationDbi)
})

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: extract one hard cluster assignment per gene from
# DEGreport::degPatterns() output.
# This is deliberately robust to DEGreport versions that name
# the gene column "genes", "gene", "name", or "gene_id".
# ------------------------------------------------------------
extract_degpatterns_assignment <- function(deg_res) {
    if (is.null(deg_res$df)) {
        stop("degPatterns result does not contain $df.")
    }

    d <- as.data.frame(deg_res$df)

    gene_candidates <- c("gene_id", "genes", "gene", "name")
    gene_col <- gene_candidates[gene_candidates %in% colnames(d)][1]

    if (length(gene_col) == 0 || is.na(gene_col)) {
        stop(
            "Cannot identify the gene column in degPatterns$df. Columns are: ",
            paste(colnames(d), collapse = ", ")
        )
    }

    if (!"cluster" %in% colnames(d)) {
        stop(
            "degPatterns$df does not contain a 'cluster' column. Columns are: ",
            paste(colnames(d), collapse = ", ")
        )
    }

    ans <- unique(
        d[, c(gene_col, "cluster"), drop = FALSE]
    )

    colnames(ans)[1] <- "gene_id"
    ans$gene_id <- as.character(ans$gene_id)

    # Convert cluster labels to integers when possible.
    cluster_chr <- as.character(ans$cluster)
    cluster_num <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(cluster_chr))

    if (anyNA(cluster_num)) {
        cluster_num2 <- suppressWarnings(
            as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]+", "", cluster_chr))
        )
        cluster_num[is.na(cluster_num)] <- cluster_num2[is.na(cluster_num)]
    }

    if (anyNA(cluster_num)) {
        stop(
            "Failed to convert some degPatterns cluster labels to integers: ",
            paste(unique(cluster_chr[is.na(cluster_num)]), collapse = ", ")
        )
    }

    ans$cluster <- cluster_num

    # Each gene must belong to one and only one hard cluster.
    dup_check <- ans %>%
        dplyr::count(gene_id, name = "n_cluster") %>%
        dplyr::filter(n_cluster > 1)

    if (nrow(dup_check) > 0) {
        stop(
            "Some genes were assigned to more than one degPatterns cluster. Example: ",
            paste(head(dup_check$gene_id, 10), collapse = ", ")
        )
    }

    ans <- ans[order(ans$cluster, ans$gene_id), , drop = FALSE]
    rownames(ans) <- NULL
    ans
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Core analysis for one sex
#
# Important:
#   * LRT has NO time ordering.
#   * full model    = ~ genotype
#   * reduced model = ~ 1
#   * genotype is treated as a categorical factor.
#   * degPatterns is used only after LRT to group genes with
#     similar expression patterns across the three genotypes.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
run_count_LRT_degPatterns_by_sex <- function(
  count_mat,
  sample_info,
  sex_use = "F",
  layer_name = "RNA",
  padj_cutoff = 0.01,
  n_clusters = 6,
  genotype_ref = "WBg",
  genotype_order = c("AdarG", "WBg", "AdarS"),
  out_dir = ".",
  fitType = "local",
  scale_patterns = TRUE,
  plot_width = 11,
  plot_height = 7.5
) {
    dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

    # =========================
    # 1. Subset one sex
    # =========================
    sample_info_sex <- sample_info[
        sample_info$sex == sex_use, ,
        drop = FALSE
    ]

    sample_info_sex <- sample_info_sex[
        colnames(count_mat)[
            colnames(count_mat) %in% sample_info_sex$sample
        ], ,
        drop = FALSE
    ]

    mat_sex <- count_mat[, sample_info_sex$sample, drop = FALSE]
    mat_sex <- round(as.matrix(mat_sex))
    mode(mat_sex) <- "integer"

    stopifnot(all(colnames(mat_sex) == rownames(sample_info_sex)))

    # Keep the same sex-specific low-count filter used in the
    # revised Figure 5 analysis.
    keep <- rowSums(mat_sex) >= 100
    mat_sex <- mat_sex[keep, , drop = FALSE]

    message(
        layer_name, " ", sex_use,
        ": genes after count filter = ", nrow(mat_sex)
    )

    # =========================
    # 2. DESeq2 LRT
    # =========================
    coldata <- sample_info_sex

    # DESeq2 model reference is WBg, but the LRT P value itself is
    # invariant to which genotype is chosen as the reference level.
    coldata$genotype <- factor(coldata$genotype)
    coldata$genotype <- relevel(coldata$genotype, ref = genotype_ref)

    dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
        countData = mat_sex,
        colData = coldata,
        design = ~genotype
    )

    dds <- DESeq(
        dds,
        test = "LRT",
        reduced = ~1,
        fitType = fitType
    )

    res_LRT <- results(dds, alpha = padj_cutoff)

    res_tbl <- as.data.frame(res_LRT) %>%
        rownames_to_column(var = "gene_id") %>%
        as_tibble() %>%
        arrange(padj)

    sig_tbl <- res_tbl %>%
        filter(!is.na(padj), padj < padj_cutoff)

    sig_genes <- sig_tbl$gene_id

    message(
        layer_name, " ", sex_use,
        ": significant LRT genes padj < ", padj_cutoff,
        " = ", length(sig_genes)
    )

    lrt_file <- file.path(
        out_dir,
        paste0(layer_name, "_", sex_use, "_DESeq2_LRT_all_results.tsv")
    )

    sig_file <- file.path(
        out_dir,
        paste0(
            layer_name, "_", sex_use,
            "_DESeq2_LRT_sig_padj", padj_cutoff, ".tsv"
        )
    )

    fwrite(res_tbl, file = lrt_file, sep = "\t")
    fwrite(sig_tbl, file = sig_file, sep = "\t")

    # =========================
    # 3. VST for PCA and clustering
    # =========================
    vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE, fitType = fitType)
    vst_mat <- assay(vsd)

    # =========================
    # 4. PCA
    # =========================
    pca_data <- plotPCA(
        vsd,
        intgroup = "genotype",
        returnData = TRUE
    )

    percentVar <- round(100 * attr(pca_data, "percentVar"))

    p_pca <- ggplot(
        pca_data,
        aes(PC1, PC2, color = genotype, label = name)
    ) +
        geom_point(size = 4) +
        geom_text(vjust = -0.8, size = 3) +
        theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
        labs(
            title = paste0(layer_name, " ", sex_use, " PCA"),
            x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance"),
            y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance")
        )

    pca_pdf <- file.path(
        out_dir,
        paste0(layer_name, "_", sex_use, "_PCA.pdf")
    )

    ggsave(pca_pdf, p_pca, width = 7, height = 6)

    # =========================
    # 5. Check number of LRT genes
    # =========================
    if (length(sig_genes) < 2) {
        warning(
            layer_name, " ", sex_use,
            ": too few significant genes for degPatterns."
        )

        return(list(
            layer = layer_name,
            sex = sex_use,
            dds = dds,
            res_LRT = res_LRT,
            res_tbl = res_tbl,
            sig_tbl = sig_tbl,
            sig_genes = sig_genes,
            vsd = vsd,
            vst_mat = vst_mat,
            pca_plot = p_pca,
            pca_pdf = pca_pdf,
            degpatterns_input = NULL,
            degpatterns = NULL,
            cluster_assignment = NULL,
            cluster_result_table = NULL,
            cluster_result_file = NULL,
            cluster_pdf = NULL
        ))
    }

    # =========================
    # 6. LRT-significant genes for degPatterns
    # =========================
    sig_genes <- intersect(sig_genes, rownames(vst_mat))
    cluster_vst <- vst_mat[sig_genes, , drop = FALSE]

    # Remove rows with non-finite or zero-variance VST values.
    finite_keep <- apply(
        cluster_vst,
        1,
        function(z) all(is.finite(z))
    )

    cluster_vst <- cluster_vst[finite_keep, , drop = FALSE]

    var_keep <- apply(cluster_vst, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
    cluster_vst <- cluster_vst[var_keep, , drop = FALSE]

    if (nrow(cluster_vst) < 2) {
        stop(
            layer_name, " ", sex_use,
            ": fewer than two clusterable LRT-significant genes remain."
        )
    }

    # Metadata used for degPatterns. genotype_order affects display only;
    # it does NOT introduce a time model into the LRT.
    pattern_coldata <- as.data.frame(coldata)
    pattern_coldata <- pattern_coldata[colnames(cluster_vst), , drop = FALSE]
    pattern_coldata$genotype <- factor(
        as.character(pattern_coldata$genotype),
        levels = genotype_order
    )

    if (anyNA(pattern_coldata$genotype)) {
        stop(
            "Some genotype labels are absent from genotype_order: ",
            paste(
                unique(as.character(coldata$genotype)[
                    !as.character(coldata$genotype) %in% genotype_order
                ]),
                collapse = ", "
            )
        )
    }

    # If the requested number of clusters exceeds the number of genes,
    # reduce it automatically rather than failing cryptically.
    n_clusters_use <- min(as.integer(n_clusters), nrow(cluster_vst))

    if (n_clusters_use < 2) {
        stop("n_clusters must be at least 2.")
    }

    # =========================
    # 7. degPatterns clustering
    # =========================
    # This restores the old Figure 5 clustering/plotting framework,
    # while retaining the revised LRT threshold, VST, QC, GO, and
    # edited-gene enrichment analyses.
    deg_res <- DEGreport::degPatterns(
        cluster_vst,
        pattern_coldata,
        time = "genotype",
        col = NULL,
        nClusters = n_clusters_use,
        scale = scale_patterns
    )

    cluster_assignment <- extract_degpatterns_assignment(deg_res)

    # Only retain genes that were actually assigned by degPatterns.
    clustered_genes <- cluster_assignment$gene_id

    # =========================
    # 8. Genotype-average VST values
    # =========================
    mat_clustered <- cluster_vst[
        clustered_genes, ,
        drop = FALSE
    ]

    mat_avg <- sapply(
        genotype_order,
        function(g) {
            cols <- rownames(pattern_coldata)[
                pattern_coldata$genotype == g
            ]
            rowMeans(mat_clustered[, cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
        }
    )

    mat_avg <- as.data.frame(mat_avg)
    mat_avg$gene_id <- rownames(mat_avg)

    # =========================
    # 9. Build complete cluster result table
    # =========================
    cluster_result <- merge(
        cluster_assignment,
        mat_avg,
        by = "gene_id",
        all.x = TRUE,
        sort = FALSE
    )

    cluster_result <- merge(
        cluster_result,
        as.data.frame(res_tbl),
        by = "gene_id",
        all.x = TRUE,
        sort = FALSE
    )

    cluster_result <- cluster_result[
        order(cluster_result$cluster, cluster_result$padj, cluster_result$gene_id), ,
        drop = FALSE
    ]

    cluster_file <- file.path(
        out_dir,
        paste0(layer_name, "_", sex_use, "_degPatterns_cluster_results.tsv")
    )

    fwrite(cluster_result, cluster_file, sep = "\t")

    # Raw long-format data returned by degPatterns, useful for QC/replotting.
    cluster_plot_data_file <- file.path(
        out_dir,
        paste0(layer_name, "_", sex_use, "_degPatterns_plot_data.tsv")
    )

    fwrite(
        as.data.frame(deg_res$df),
        cluster_plot_data_file,
        sep = "\t"
    )

    # Cluster sizes.
    cluster_sizes <- cluster_assignment %>%
        dplyr::count(cluster, name = "n_genes") %>%
        dplyr::arrange(cluster)

    cluster_sizes_file <- file.path(
        out_dir,
        paste0(layer_name, "_", sex_use, "_degPatterns_cluster_sizes.tsv")
    )

    fwrite(cluster_sizes, cluster_sizes_file, sep = "\t")

    # One file per cluster for downstream inspection.
    for (k in sort(unique(cluster_result$cluster))) {
        cluster_k <- cluster_result[
            cluster_result$cluster == k, ,
            drop = FALSE
        ]

        fwrite(
            cluster_k,
            file.path(
                out_dir,
                paste0(
                    layer_name, "_", sex_use,
                    "_degPatterns_cluster", k, ".tsv"
                )
            ),
            sep = "\t"
        )
    }

    # =========================
    # 10. Save old-style degPatterns figure
    # =========================
    cluster_pdf <- file.path(
        out_dir,
        paste0(
            layer_name, "_", sex_use,
            "_degPatterns_c", n_clusters_use, ".pdf"
        )
    )

    if (!is.null(deg_res$plot)) {
        ggsave(
            cluster_pdf,
            plot = deg_res$plot,
            width = plot_width,
            height = plot_height
        )
    } else {
        warning(
            "degPatterns result does not contain $plot; no cluster PDF was saved."
        )
        cluster_pdf <- NA_character_
    }

    # =========================
    # 11. QC: cluster-centre similarity
    # =========================
    # This is NOT used to redefine clusters. It only flags whether the
    # requested nClusters may have split very similar expression patterns.
    centre_df <- cluster_result %>%
        dplyr::select(gene_id, cluster, dplyr::all_of(genotype_order)) %>%
        tidyr::pivot_longer(
            cols = dplyr::all_of(genotype_order),
            names_to = "genotype",
            values_to = "value"
        ) %>%
        dplyr::group_by(cluster, genotype) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(
            centre = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        tidyr::pivot_wider(
            names_from = genotype,
            values_from = centre
        ) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(cluster)

    centre_mat <- as.matrix(
        centre_df[, genotype_order, drop = FALSE]
    )
    rownames(centre_mat) <- paste0("Cluster", centre_df$cluster)

    cluster_center_cor <- cor(
        t(centre_mat),
        use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
    )

    cluster_center_distance <- as.matrix(dist(centre_mat))

    cluster_center_cor_file <- file.path(
        out_dir,
        paste0(
            layer_name, "_", sex_use,
            "_degPatterns_cluster_center_correlation.tsv"
        )
    )

    cluster_center_distance_file <- file.path(
        out_dir,
        paste0(
            layer_name, "_", sex_use,
            "_degPatterns_cluster_center_distance.tsv"
        )
    )

    fwrite(
        data.frame(
            cluster = rownames(cluster_center_cor),
            cluster_center_cor,
            check.names = FALSE
        ),
        cluster_center_cor_file,
        sep = "\t"
    )

    fwrite(
        data.frame(
            cluster = rownames(cluster_center_distance),
            cluster_center_distance,
            check.names = FALSE
        ),
        cluster_center_distance_file,
        sep = "\t"
    )

    similar_pairs <- which(
        upper.tri(cluster_center_cor) &
            cluster_center_cor >= 0.90,
        arr.ind = TRUE
    )

    if (nrow(similar_pairs) > 0) {
        similar_pair_labels <- apply(
            similar_pairs,
            1,
            function(z) {
                paste0(
                    rownames(cluster_center_cor)[z[1]],
                    "-",
                    colnames(cluster_center_cor)[z[2]]
                )
            }
        )

        warning(
            layer_name, " ", sex_use,
            ": highly similar degPatterns cluster centres (cor >= 0.90): ",
            paste(similar_pair_labels, collapse = ", "),
            ". Consider testing a smaller n_clusters as a sensitivity analysis."
        )
    }

    message("Saved: ", lrt_file)
    message("Saved: ", pca_pdf)
    message("Saved: ", cluster_file)
    message("Saved: ", cluster_pdf)

    return(list(
        layer = layer_name,
        sex = sex_use,
        dds = dds,
        res_LRT = res_LRT,
        res_tbl = res_tbl,
        sig_tbl = sig_tbl,
        sig_genes = sig_genes,
        vsd = vsd,
        vst_mat = vst_mat,
        pca_plot = p_pca,
        pca_pdf = pca_pdf,
        degpatterns_input = cluster_vst,
        degpatterns_coldata = pattern_coldata,
        degpatterns = deg_res,
        cluster_assignment = cluster_assignment,
        cluster_result_table = cluster_result,
        cluster_result_file = cluster_file,
        cluster_plot_data_file = cluster_plot_data_file,
        cluster_sizes = cluster_sizes,
        cluster_sizes_file = cluster_sizes_file,
        cluster_pdf = cluster_pdf,
        cluster_center_cor = cluster_center_cor,
        cluster_center_distance = cluster_center_distance,
        cluster_center_cor_file = cluster_center_cor_file,
        cluster_center_distance_file = cluster_center_distance_file
    ))
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Convert gene IDs to FlyBase IDs for clusterProfiler.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
convert_to_flybase <- function(gene_ids) {
    gene_ids <- unique(gene_ids)
    gene_ids <- gene_ids[!is.na(gene_ids)]
    gene_ids <- gene_ids[gene_ids != ""]

    flybase_direct <- gene_ids[grepl("^FBgn", gene_ids)]
    symbol_ids <- gene_ids[!grepl("^FBgn", gene_ids)]

    if (length(symbol_ids) > 0) {
        symbol_to_fb <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
            org.Dm.eg.db,
            keys = unique(symbol_ids),
            keytype = "SYMBOL",
            column = "FLYBASE",
            multiVals = "first"
        )

        flybase_from_symbol <- unname(symbol_to_fb)
        flybase_from_symbol <- flybase_from_symbol[
            !is.na(flybase_from_symbol)
        ]
    } else {
        flybase_from_symbol <- character(0)
    }

    flybase_all <- unique(c(flybase_direct, flybase_from_symbol))
    flybase_all <- flybase_all[!is.na(flybase_all)]

    flybase_all
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# GO enrichment for degPatterns clusters.
# The statistical settings are kept from the revised Figure 5:
#   ont = BP, BH, pvalueCutoff = 0.05, qvalueCutoff = 0.2.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
run_count_degPatterns_cluster_GO <- function(
  cluster_files,
  sex_names = c("F", "M"),
  background_genes,
  layer_name = "RNA",
  ont = "BP",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
  top_n = 10,
  out_prefix = "RNA_degPatterns_GO"
) {
    if (length(cluster_files) != length(sex_names)) {
        stop("cluster_files and sex_names must have the same length.")
    }

    if (
        !is.list(background_genes) ||
            is.null(names(background_genes)) ||
            !all(sex_names %in% names(background_genes))
    ) {
        stop(
            "background_genes must be a named list containing one gene set per sex: ",
            paste(sex_names, collapse = ", ")
        )
    }

    bg_flybase_by_sex <- lapply(
        background_genes[sex_names],
        convert_to_flybase
    )
    names(bg_flybase_by_sex) <- sex_names

    all_go_df <- list()

    for (i in seq_along(cluster_files)) {
        cluster_file <- cluster_files[i]
        sex_use <- sex_names[i]

        background_genes_use <- background_genes[[sex_use]]
        bg_flybase <- bg_flybase_by_sex[[sex_use]]

        message(
            layer_name, " ", sex_use,
            " background genes: ", length(background_genes_use)
        )

        message(
            layer_name, " ", sex_use,
            " background FlyBase genes: ", length(bg_flybase)
        )

        if (!file.exists(cluster_file)) {
            warning("File does not exist: ", cluster_file)
            next
        }

        cluster_df <- fread(cluster_file)
        cluster_df <- as.data.frame(cluster_df)

        required_cols <- c("gene_id", "cluster")
        missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(cluster_df))

        if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
            stop(
                "degPatterns cluster result file is missing columns: ",
                paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
            )
        }

        clusters <- sort(unique(cluster_df$cluster))

        for (cl in clusters) {
            sub_df <- cluster_df %>%
                dplyr::filter(cluster == cl)

            gene_cl <- convert_to_flybase(sub_df$gene_id)
            gene_cl <- unique(gene_cl)

            message(
                layer_name, " ", sex_use, " cluster ", cl,
                ": input genes = ", nrow(sub_df),
                ", FlyBase genes = ", length(gene_cl)
            )

            if (length(gene_cl) < 5) {
                message(
                    "Skip ", layer_name, " ", sex_use,
                    " cluster ", cl, ": too few genes."
                )
                next
            }

            ego <- enrichGO(
                gene = gene_cl,
                universe = bg_flybase,
                OrgDb = org.Dm.eg.db,
                keyType = "FLYBASE",
                ont = ont,
                pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                pvalueCutoff = pvalueCutoff,
                qvalueCutoff = qvalueCutoff,
                readable = TRUE
            )

            ego_df <- as.data.frame(ego)

            if (nrow(ego_df) == 0) {
                message(
                    "No enriched GO terms for ",
                    layer_name, " ", sex_use, " cluster ", cl
                )
                next
            }

            ego_df$layer <- layer_name
            ego_df$sex <- sex_use
            ego_df$cluster <- cl
            ego_df$group <- paste0(layer_name, "_", sex_use, "_C", cl)
            ego_df$input_gene_n <- length(gene_cl)
            ego_df$input_raw_n <- nrow(sub_df)

            all_go_df[[
                paste0(layer_name, "_", sex_use, "_C", cl)
            ]] <- ego_df
        }
    }

    if (length(all_go_df) == 0) {
        warning("No GO enrichment results found for ", layer_name)
        return(NULL)
    }

    go_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_go_df)

    go_outfile <- paste0(out_prefix, "_all_GO_", ont, ".tsv")

    write.table(
        go_all,
        file = go_outfile,
        sep = "\t",
        quote = FALSE,
        row.names = FALSE
    )

    message("GO result table saved to: ", go_outfile)

    go_plot_df <- go_all %>%
        dplyr::group_by(group) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(p.adjust, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
        dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
        dplyr::ungroup()

    go_plot_df$GeneRatio_num <- sapply(
        go_plot_df$GeneRatio,
        function(x) {
            tmp <- strsplit(x, "/")[[1]]
            as.numeric(tmp[1]) / as.numeric(tmp[2])
        }
    )

    go_plot_df$Description <- factor(
        go_plot_df$Description,
        levels = rev(unique(go_plot_df$Description))
    )

    go_plot_df$group <- factor(
        go_plot_df$group,
        levels = sort(unique(go_plot_df$group))
    )

    p <- ggplot(
        go_plot_df,
        aes(
            x = GeneRatio_num,
            y = Description,
            size = Count,
            color = -log10(p.adjust)
        )
    ) +
        geom_point() +
        facet_wrap(~group, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
        theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
        labs(
            x = "GeneRatio",
            y = NULL,
            size = "Gene count",
            color = "-log10(FDR)",
            title = paste0(
                layer_name,
                " GO enrichment of degPatterns clusters: ",
                ont
            )
        ) +
        theme(
            strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
        )

    pdf_file <- paste0(out_prefix, "_GO_", ont, ".pdf")

    ggsave(pdf_file, p, width = 20, height = 10)
    message("GO plot saved to: ", pdf_file)

    return(list(
        go_all = go_all,
        go_plot_df = go_plot_df,
        plot = p,
        background_flybase = bg_flybase_by_sex,
        go_table_file = go_outfile,
        go_pdf = pdf_file
    ))
}
```

```{r}
# Run RNA Figure 5 analysis

setwd("/path/to/F5_AdarSG/")
base_dir <- "/path/to/F5_AdarSG"
```

```{r}
# cluster enrichment
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(data.table)
    library(ggplot2)
})

# ============================================================
# 1. User settings
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Editing-site files
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# All A-to-G editing sites
all_site_file <- "/path/to/Figure_new/sites/ISO1.candidate.AtoG.annotations.long.tsv"

# One annotation row per site, mapping alledit site_key to gene
site_annotation_file <- "/path/to/Figure_new/sites/ISO1.candidate.detected.annotated.tsv"

# alledit CDS-position table
alledit_file <- paste0(
    "/path/to/Figure_new/sites/ISO1.candidate.rescue_3R_18907675.",
    "sourceCDS.keepTargetUTR3.cdspos_for_alledit.tsv"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# DESeq2 / degPatterns previous output directory
# ------------------------------------------------------------

count_out_dir <- "/path/to/F5_AdarSG/RNA_LRT_degPatterns/"

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Previous DESeq2 LRT results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

lrt_files <- c(
    F = file.path(
        count_out_dir,
        "RNA_F_DESeq2_LRT_all_results.tsv"
    ),
    M = file.path(
        count_out_dir,
        "RNA_M_DESeq2_LRT_all_results.tsv"
    )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Previous degPatterns cluster results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cluster_files <- c(
    F = file.path(
        count_out_dir,
        "RNA_F_degPatterns_cluster_results.tsv"
    ),
    M = file.path(
        count_out_dir,
        "RNA_M_degPatterns_cluster_results.tsv"
    )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ------------------------------------------------------------

out_dir <- file.path(
    count_out_dir,
    "RNA_editing_gene_DE_cluster_enrichment"
)

dir.create(
    out_dir,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Parameters
# ------------------------------------------------------------

padj_cutoff <- 0.01

# degPatterns is a hard-clustering method, so there is no degPatterns membership filter.


# ============================================================
# 2. Helper
# ============================================================

clean_gene_id <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)

    x <- trimws(x)

    x[
        is.na(x) |
            x == "" |
            x == "NA" |
            x == "."
    ] <- NA_character_

    x
}


safe_fraction <- function(x, n) {
    if (n == 0) {
        return(NA_real_)
    }

    x / n
}


# ============================================================
# 3. Extract edited genes:
#    Definition 1 = all editing sites
# ============================================================

cat("\n")
cat("============================================================\n")
cat("[1] Extract edited genes from ALL editing sites\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

if (!file.exists(all_site_file)) {
    stop("File does not exist: ", all_site_file)
}

all_sites <- fread(
    all_site_file,
    select = c(
        "handle",
        "gene",
        "change2"
    )
)

all_sites[, gene := clean_gene_id(gene)]

# Explicitly restrict the input to A-to-G sites
all_sites <- all_sites[
    change2 == "A>G"
]

n_all_rows <- nrow(all_sites)

n_all_sites <- uniqueN(
    all_sites$handle
)

n_all_sites_with_gene <- uniqueN(
    all_sites[
        !is.na(gene),
        handle
    ]
)

n_all_sites_without_gene <-
    n_all_sites -
    n_all_sites_with_gene


# Check whether a handle maps to multiple genes
handle_gene_check <- unique(
    all_sites[
        !is.na(gene),
        .(
            handle,
            gene
        )
    ]
)

handle_gene_conflict <- handle_gene_check[
    ,
    .(
        n_gene = uniqueN(gene)
    ),
    by = handle
][
    n_gene > 1
]

if (nrow(handle_gene_conflict) > 0) {
    stop(
        "Some editing sites map to multiple genes. ",
        "Please inspect before continuing."
    )
}


edited_genes_all_sites <- sort(
    unique(
        all_sites[
            !is.na(gene),
            gene
        ]
    )
)


cat(
    "Rows in all-site file          : ",
    n_all_rows,
    "\n"
)

cat(
    "Unique editing sites           : ",
    n_all_sites,
    "\n"
)

cat(
    "Sites with gene annotation     : ",
    n_all_sites_with_gene,
    "\n"
)

cat(
    "Sites without gene annotation  : ",
    n_all_sites_without_gene,
    "\n"
)

cat(
    "Unique edited genes [all_sites]: ",
    length(edited_genes_all_sites),
    "\n"
)


fwrite(
    data.table(
        gene_id = edited_genes_all_sites
    ),
    file.path(
        out_dir,
        "edited_genes.all_sites.tsv"
    ),
    sep = "\t"
)


# ============================================================
# 4. Build handle -> gene mapping
#    for alledit
# ============================================================

cat("\n")
cat("============================================================\n")
cat("[2] Build editing-site -> gene map\n")
cat("============================================================\n")


if (!file.exists(site_annotation_file)) {
    stop(
        "File does not exist: ",
        site_annotation_file
    )
}


site_annotation <- fread(
    site_annotation_file,
    select = c(
        "handle",
        "gene"
    )
)

site_annotation[
    ,
    gene := clean_gene_id(gene)
]


site_gene_map <- unique(
    site_annotation[
        !is.na(handle) &
            handle != "",
        .(
            handle,
            gene
        )
    ]
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Ensure each handle maps to only one non-NA gene
# ------------------------------------------------------------

map_conflict <- site_gene_map[
    !is.na(gene),
    .(
        n_gene = uniqueN(gene)
    ),
    by = handle
][
    n_gene > 1
]


if (nrow(map_conflict) > 0) {
    fwrite(
        map_conflict,
        file.path(
            out_dir,
            "ERROR.handle_multiple_gene.tsv"
        ),
        sep = "\t"
    )

    stop(
        "At least one handle maps to multiple genes."
    )
}


# Keep one row per handle
site_gene_map <- site_gene_map[
    order(
        handle,
        is.na(gene)
    )
]

site_gene_map <- site_gene_map[
    !duplicated(handle)
]


cat(
    "Unique site annotation handles: ",
    nrow(site_gene_map),
    "\n"
)


# ============================================================
# 5. Extract edited genes:
#    Definition 2 = CDS sites from alledit
# ============================================================

cat("\n")
cat("============================================================\n")
cat("[3] Extract CDS-edited genes from alledit\n")
cat("============================================================\n")


if (!file.exists(alledit_file)) {
    stop(
        "File does not exist: ",
        alledit_file
    )
}


alledit <- fread(
    alledit_file
)


required_alledit_cols <- c(
    "site_key",
    "target_region"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(
    required_alledit_cols,
    names(alledit)
)

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
        "alledit file missing columns: ",
        paste(
            missing_cols,
            collapse = ", "
        )
    )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# IMPORTANT:
# only CDS
#
# The input also contains some UTR3 sites;
# filter the input before analysis.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

alledit_CDS <- unique(
    alledit[
        target_region == "CDS",
        .(
            site_key
        )
    ]
)


cat(
    "Total alledit rows             : ",
    nrow(alledit),
    "\n"
)

cat(
    "Unique CDS alledit sites       : ",
    nrow(alledit_CDS),
    "\n"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Map CDS site_key -> gene
# ------------------------------------------------------------

alledit_CDS_gene <- merge(
    alledit_CDS,
    site_gene_map,
    by.x = "site_key",
    by.y = "handle",
    all.x = TRUE,
    sort = FALSE
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# QC: unmatched sites
# ------------------------------------------------------------

unmatched_CDS <- alledit_CDS_gene[
    is.na(gene)
]


if (nrow(unmatched_CDS) > 0) {
    fwrite(
        unmatched_CDS,
        file.path(
            out_dir,
            "alledit_CDS.unmatched_sites.tsv"
        ),
        sep = "\t"
    )

    stop(
        "Some CDS alledit sites cannot be mapped to a gene: ",
        nrow(unmatched_CDS)
    )
}


edited_genes_CDS_alledit <- sort(
    unique(
        alledit_CDS_gene$gene
    )
)


cat(
    "Mapped CDS sites               : ",
    nrow(alledit_CDS_gene),
    "\n"
)

cat(
    "Unique CDS-edited genes        : ",
    length(edited_genes_CDS_alledit),
    "\n"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Output site -> gene table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fwrite(
    alledit_CDS_gene,
    file.path(
        out_dir,
        "alledit_CDS.site_to_gene.tsv"
    ),
    sep = "\t"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Output CDS edited gene list
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fwrite(
    data.table(
        gene_id = edited_genes_CDS_alledit
    ),
    file.path(
        out_dir,
        "edited_genes.CDS_alledit.tsv"
    ),
    sep = "\t"
)


# ============================================================
# 6. Edited-gene-set QC
# ============================================================

editing_set_qc <- data.table(
    editing_definition = c(
        "all_sites",
        "CDS_alledit"
    ),
    unique_sites = c(
        n_all_sites,
        nrow(alledit_CDS)
    ),
    unique_genes = c(
        length(edited_genes_all_sites),
        length(edited_genes_CDS_alledit)
    )
)


fwrite(
    editing_set_qc,
    file.path(
        out_dir,
        "edited_gene_set.QC.tsv"
    ),
    sep = "\t"
)


cat("\nEdited gene-set QC:\n")
print(editing_set_qc)


# ============================================================
# 7. Core function
# ============================================================

run_one_enrichment <- function(
  lrt_file,
  cluster_file,
  edited_genes,
  sex_use,
  editing_definition,
  padj_cutoff = 0.01,
  out_dir = "."
) {
    cat("\n")
    cat("============================================================\n")
    cat(
        "[RUN] sex = ",
        sex_use,
        " | definition = ",
        editing_definition,
        "\n",
        sep = ""
    )
    cat("============================================================\n")


    # ==========================================================
    # 7.1 Read DESeq2 LRT
    # ==========================================================

    if (!file.exists(lrt_file)) {
        stop(
            "LRT file does not exist: ",
            lrt_file
        )
    }


    lrt <- fread(lrt_file)


    required_lrt_cols <- c(
        "gene_id",
        "padj"
    )

    missing_lrt <- setdiff(
        required_lrt_cols,
        names(lrt)
    )

    if (length(missing_lrt) > 0) {
        stop(
            "LRT file missing columns: ",
            paste(
                missing_lrt,
                collapse = ", "
            )
        )
    }


    # one row per gene
    if (anyDuplicated(lrt$gene_id)) {
        stop(
            "Duplicated gene_id found in LRT file."
        )
    }


    # ==========================================================
    # IMPORTANT:
    # padj = NA is excluded
    #
    # No_DE is explicitly:
    # padj >= 0.01
    # ==========================================================

    gene_status <- lrt[
        !is.na(padj),
        .(
            gene_id,
            padj
        )
    ]


    gene_status[
        ,
        DE_status := fifelse(
            padj < padj_cutoff,
            "DE",
            "No_DE"
        )
    ]


    gene_status[
        ,
        edited := gene_id %in% edited_genes
    ]


    cat(
        "Genes with valid padj : ",
        nrow(gene_status),
        "\n"
    )

    cat(
        "DE genes              : ",
        gene_status[
            DE_status == "DE",
            .N
        ],
        "\n"
    )

    cat(
        "No-DE genes           : ",
        gene_status[
            DE_status == "No_DE",
            .N
        ],
        "\n"
    )


    # ==========================================================
    # 7.2 PART 1:
    #     DE vs No-DE
    # ==========================================================

    de_edit <- gene_status[
        DE_status == "DE",
        sum(edited)
    ]

    de_nonedit <- gene_status[
        DE_status == "DE",
        sum(!edited)
    ]

    node_edit <- gene_status[
        DE_status == "No_DE",
        sum(edited)
    ]

    node_nonedit <- gene_status[
        DE_status == "No_DE",
        sum(!edited)
    ]


    fisher_DE_matrix <- matrix(
        c(
            de_edit,
            de_nonedit,
            node_edit,
            node_nonedit
        ),
        nrow = 2,
        byrow = TRUE,
        dimnames = list(
            c(
                "DE",
                "No_DE"
            ),
            c(
                "Edited",
                "NonEdited"
            )
        )
    )


    cat("\nDE vs No-DE contingency table:\n")
    print(fisher_DE_matrix)


    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Primary test:
    # H1 = edited genes enriched in DE
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    fisher_DE_enrichment <- fisher.test(
        fisher_DE_matrix,
        alternative = "greater"
    )


    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Also output conventional two-sided test + 95% CI
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    fisher_DE_two <- fisher.test(
        fisher_DE_matrix,
        alternative = "two.sided"
    )


    de_total <- de_edit + de_nonedit
    node_total <- node_edit + node_nonedit


    DE_result <- data.table(
        sex = sex_use,
        editing_definition =
            editing_definition,
        comparison =
            "DE_vs_No_DE",
        DE_total =
            de_total,
        DE_edited =
            de_edit,
        DE_edited_fraction =
            safe_fraction(
                de_edit,
                de_total
            ),
        NoDE_total =
            node_total,
        NoDE_edited =
            node_edit,
        NoDE_edited_fraction =
            safe_fraction(
                node_edit,
                node_total
            ),
        odds_ratio =
            unname(
                fisher_DE_two$estimate
            ),
        OR_conf_low =
            fisher_DE_two$conf.int[1],
        OR_conf_high =
            fisher_DE_two$conf.int[2],
        fisher_p_enrichment =
            fisher_DE_enrichment$p.value,
        fisher_p_two_sided =
            fisher_DE_two$p.value
    )


    # ==========================================================
    # 7.3 Read degPatterns cluster assignments
    # ==========================================================

    if (!file.exists(cluster_file)) {
        stop(
            "degPatterns cluster file does not exist: ",
            cluster_file
        )
    }


    cluster_input <- fread(
        cluster_file
    )


    required_cluster_cols <- c(
        "gene_id",
        "cluster"
    )


    missing_cluster <- setdiff(
        required_cluster_cols,
        names(cluster_input)
    )


    if (length(missing_cluster) > 0) {
        stop(
            "degPatterns cluster file missing columns: ",
            paste(
                missing_cluster,
                collapse = ", "
            )
        )
    }


    cluster_use <- unique(
        cluster_input[
            ,
            .(
                gene_id,
                cluster
            )
        ],
        by = "gene_id"
    )


    # ==========================================================
    # 7.4 Attach edited status
    # ==========================================================

    cluster_df <- merge(
        cluster_use,
        gene_status[
            ,
            .(
                gene_id,
                DE_status,
                edited
            )
        ],
        by = "gene_id",
        all = FALSE
    )


    # degPatterns cluster file should contain only LRT-significant DE genes
    cluster_df <- cluster_df[
        DE_status == "DE"
    ]


    cluster_df[
        ,
        group := paste0(
            "Cluster",
            cluster
        )
    ]


    # ==========================================================
    # 7.5 DE genes that were not clusterable
    # ==========================================================

    all_DE_genes <- gene_status[
        DE_status == "DE",
        gene_id
    ]


    clustered_DE_genes <- unique(
        cluster_df$gene_id
    )


    DE_unclustered <- setdiff(
        all_DE_genes,
        clustered_DE_genes
    )


    cat(
        "DE genes assigned to cluster   : ",
        length(clustered_DE_genes),
        "\n"
    )

    cat(
        "DE genes not in degPatterns clusters: ",
        length(DE_unclustered),
        "\n"
    )


    if (length(DE_unclustered) > 0) {
        fwrite(
            data.table(
                gene_id = DE_unclustered
            ),
            file.path(
                out_dir,
                paste0(
                    "RNA_",
                    sex_use,
                    ".",
                    editing_definition,
                    ".DE_unclustered_genes.tsv"
                )
            ),
            sep = "\t"
        )
    }


    # ==========================================================
    # 7.6 Build No_DE + cluster table
    # ==========================================================

    noDE_df <- gene_status[
        DE_status == "No_DE",
        .(
            gene_id,
            edited
        )
    ]


    noDE_df[
        ,
        group := "No_DE"
    ]


    cluster_for_test <- cluster_df[
        ,
        .(
            gene_id,
            edited,
            group
        )
    ]


    group_df <- rbindlist(
        list(
            noDE_df,
            cluster_for_test
        ),
        use.names = TRUE
    )


    # ==========================================================
    # 7.7 Summary:
    #     edited fraction in each group
    # ==========================================================

    group_summary <- group_df[
        ,
        .(
            total_genes =
                .N,
            edited_genes =
                sum(edited),
            nonedited_genes =
                sum(!edited),
            edited_fraction =
                mean(edited)
        ),
        by = group
    ]


    group_summary[, order_tmp := 0L]

    group_summary[
        group != "No_DE",
        order_tmp := as.integer(
            sub(
                "^Cluster",
                "",
                group
            )
        )
    ]


    setorder(
        group_summary,
        order_tmp
    )


    group_summary[
        ,
        order_tmp := NULL
    ]


    group_summary[
        ,
        `:=`(
            sex =
                sex_use,
            editing_definition =
                editing_definition
        )
    ]


    # ==========================================================
    # 7.8 Global Fisher:
    #
    #            Edited  NonEdited
    # No_DE
    # Cluster1
    # Cluster2
    # ...
    # ==========================================================

    global_matrix <- as.matrix(
        group_summary[
            ,
            .(
                edited_genes,
                nonedited_genes
            )
        ]
    )


    rownames(global_matrix) <-
        group_summary$group

    colnames(global_matrix) <-
        c(
            "Edited",
            "NonEdited"
        )


    cat("\nGlobal contingency table:\n")
    print(global_matrix)


    set.seed(analysis_seed)


    global_fisher <- tryCatch(
        fisher.test(
            global_matrix,
            workspace = 2e8
        ),
        error = function(e) {
            message(
                "Exact global Fisher failed; ",
                "switch to Fisher Monte Carlo."
            )

            fisher.test(
                global_matrix,
                simulate.p.value = TRUE,
                B = 1000000
            )
        }
    )


    global_result <- data.table(
        sex =
            sex_use,
        editing_definition =
            editing_definition,
        test =
            "No_DE_vs_all_clusters_global",
        fisher_p =
            global_fisher$p.value,
        method =
            global_fisher$method
    )


    # ==========================================================
    # 7.9 Pairwise:
    #     each cluster vs No_DE
    # ==========================================================

    noDE_row <- group_summary[
        group == "No_DE"
    ]


    cluster_names <- group_summary[
        group != "No_DE",
        group
    ]


    pairwise_list <- vector(
        "list",
        length(cluster_names)
    )


    for (
        i in seq_along(
            cluster_names
        )
    ) {
        g <- cluster_names[i]


        g_row <- group_summary[
            group == g
        ]


        pair_mat <- matrix(
            c(
                g_row$edited_genes,
                g_row$nonedited_genes,
                noDE_row$edited_genes,
                noDE_row$nonedited_genes
            ),
            nrow = 2,
            byrow = TRUE,
            dimnames = list(
                c(
                    g,
                    "No_DE"
                ),
                c(
                    "Edited",
                    "NonEdited"
                )
            )
        )


        # H1:
        # edited genes enriched in this cluster
        ft_enrich <- fisher.test(
            pair_mat,
            alternative = "greater"
        )


        ft_two <- fisher.test(
            pair_mat,
            alternative = "two.sided"
        )


        pairwise_list[[i]] <- data.table(
            sex =
                sex_use,
            editing_definition =
                editing_definition,
            group =
                g,
            group_total =
                g_row$total_genes,
            group_edited =
                g_row$edited_genes,
            group_edited_fraction =
                g_row$edited_fraction,
            NoDE_total =
                noDE_row$total_genes,
            NoDE_edited =
                noDE_row$edited_genes,
            NoDE_edited_fraction =
                noDE_row$edited_fraction,
            odds_ratio =
                unname(
                    ft_two$estimate
                ),
            OR_conf_low =
                ft_two$conf.int[1],
            OR_conf_high =
                ft_two$conf.int[2],
            fisher_p_enrichment =
                ft_enrich$p.value,
            fisher_p_two_sided =
                ft_two$p.value
        )
    }


    pairwise_result <- rbindlist(
        pairwise_list
    )


    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # BH correction:
    # separately within this sex <U+00D7> editing definition
    # ----------------------------------------------------------

    pairwise_result[
        ,
        fisher_p_enrichment_BH :=
            p.adjust(
                fisher_p_enrichment,
                method = "BH"
            )
    ]


    pairwise_result[
        ,
        fisher_p_two_sided_BH :=
            p.adjust(
                fisher_p_two_sided,
                method = "BH"
            )
    ]


    pairwise_result[
        ,
        enriched :=
            odds_ratio > 1 &
                fisher_p_enrichment_BH < 0.05
    ]


    # ==========================================================
    # 7.10 Output current analysis
    # ==========================================================

    prefix <- paste0(
        "RNA_",
        sex_use,
        ".",
        editing_definition
    )


    fwrite(
        gene_status,
        file.path(
            out_dir,
            paste0(
                prefix,
                ".gene_DE_editing_status.tsv"
            )
        ),
        sep = "\t"
    )


    fwrite(
        DE_result,
        file.path(
            out_dir,
            paste0(
                prefix,
                ".DE_vs_NoDE.fisher.tsv"
            )
        ),
        sep = "\t"
    )


    fwrite(
        group_summary,
        file.path(
            out_dir,
            paste0(
                prefix,
                ".NoDE_cluster.edited_fraction.tsv"
            )
        ),
        sep = "\t"
    )


    fwrite(
        global_result,
        file.path(
            out_dir,
            paste0(
                prefix,
                ".NoDE_cluster.global_fisher.tsv"
            )
        ),
        sep = "\t"
    )


    fwrite(
        pairwise_result,
        file.path(
            out_dir,
            paste0(
                prefix,
                ".cluster_vs_NoDE.fisher.tsv"
            )
        ),
        sep = "\t"
    )


    cat("\nDE vs No-DE result:\n")
    print(DE_result)

    cat("\nGroup summary:\n")
    print(group_summary)

    cat("\nCluster vs No-DE:\n")
    print(pairwise_result)


    return(
        list(
            DE =
                DE_result,
            group_summary =
                group_summary,
            global =
                global_result,
            pairwise =
                pairwise_result
        )
    )
}


# ============================================================
# 8. Two editing definitions
# ============================================================

editing_definitions <- list(
    all_sites =
        edited_genes_all_sites,
    CDS_alledit =
        edited_genes_CDS_alledit
)


# ============================================================
# 9. Run F + M <U+00D7> two definitions
# ============================================================

all_results <- list()

for (
    sex_use in c(
        "F",
        "M"
    )
) {
    for (
        definition in names(
            editing_definitions
        )
    ) {
        key <- paste(
            sex_use,
            definition,
            sep = "_"
        )


        all_results[[key]] <-
            run_one_enrichment(
                lrt_file =
                    lrt_files[[sex_use]],
                cluster_file =
                    cluster_files[[sex_use]],
                edited_genes =
                    editing_definitions[[definition]],
                sex_use =
                    sex_use,
                editing_definition =
                    definition,
                padj_cutoff =
                    padj_cutoff,
                out_dir =
                    out_dir
            )
    }
}


# ============================================================
# 10. Merge all DE vs No-DE results
# ============================================================

DE_all <- rbindlist(
    lapply(
        all_results,
        `[[`,
        "DE"
    ),
    fill = TRUE
)


# 4 primary tests:
# F/M <U+00D7> all_sites/CDS_alledit
DE_all[
    ,
    fisher_p_enrichment_BH :=
        p.adjust(
            fisher_p_enrichment,
            method = "BH"
        )
]


DE_all[
    ,
    fisher_p_two_sided_BH :=
        p.adjust(
            fisher_p_two_sided,
            method = "BH"
        )
]


DE_all[
    ,
    enriched_in_DE :=
        odds_ratio > 1 &
            fisher_p_enrichment_BH < 0.05
]


fwrite(
    DE_all,
    file.path(
        out_dir,
        "ALL.DE_vs_NoDE.fisher.tsv"
    ),
    sep = "\t"
)


# ============================================================
# 11. Merge all group summaries
# ============================================================

group_summary_all <- rbindlist(
    lapply(
        all_results,
        `[[`,
        "group_summary"
    ),
    fill = TRUE
)


fwrite(
    group_summary_all,
    file.path(
        out_dir,
        "ALL.NoDE_cluster.edited_fraction.tsv"
    ),
    sep = "\t"
)


# ============================================================
# 12. Merge global Fisher results
# ============================================================

global_all <- rbindlist(
    lapply(
        all_results,
        `[[`,
        "global"
    ),
    fill = TRUE
)


global_all[
    ,
    fisher_p_BH :=
        p.adjust(
            fisher_p,
            method = "BH"
        )
]


fwrite(
    global_all,
    file.path(
        out_dir,
        "ALL.NoDE_cluster.global_fisher.tsv"
    ),
    sep = "\t"
)


# ============================================================
# 13. Merge cluster vs No-DE
# ============================================================

pairwise_all <- rbindlist(
    lapply(
        all_results,
        `[[`,
        "pairwise"
    ),
    fill = TRUE
)


fwrite(
    pairwise_all,
    file.path(
        out_dir,
        "ALL.cluster_vs_NoDE.fisher.tsv"
    ),
    sep = "\t"
)


# ============================================================
# 14. Grouped bar plots
#     Make the enrichment results directly interpretable
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Which P value should be printed on the bars?
#
# "two_sided":
#   Fisher two-sided test; asks whether the edited-gene
#   proportion differs from No-DE in either direction.
#
# "enrichment":
#   one-sided Fisher test; asks specifically whether edited
#   genes are enriched relative to No-DE.
#
# Because the figure is intended to show "difference P",
# two-sided Fisher is used by default.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_p_mode <- "two_sided"

if (!plot_p_mode %in% c("two_sided", "enrichment")) {
    stop("plot_p_mode must be 'two_sided' or 'enrichment'.")
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Pretty P-value labels
# ------------------------------------------------------------

format_plot_p <- function(p) {
    if (is.na(p)) {
        return("")
    }

    if (p < 2.2e-16) {
        return("BH P < 2.2e-16")
    }

    if (p < 0.001) {
        return(
            paste0(
                "BH P = ",
                formatC(
                    p,
                    format = "e",
                    digits = 1
                )
            )
        )
    }

    paste0(
        "BH P = ",
        formatC(
            p,
            format = "f",
            digits = 3
        )
    )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Common display labels
# ------------------------------------------------------------

editing_definition_levels <- c(
    "all_sites",
    "CDS_alledit"
)

editing_definition_labels <- c(
    "All editing genes",
    "CDS-edited genes"
)

sex_levels <- c(
    "F",
    "M"
)

sex_labels <- c(
    "Female",
    "Male"
)


# ============================================================
# 14.1 Figure A:
#      DE vs No-DE
# ============================================================

DE_plot_df <- rbindlist(
    list(
        DE_all[
            ,
            .(
                sex,
                editing_definition,
                group = "No_DE",
                total_genes = NoDE_total,
                edited_genes = NoDE_edited,
                edited_fraction = NoDE_edited_fraction
            )
        ],
        DE_all[
            ,
            .(
                sex,
                editing_definition,
                group = "DE",
                total_genes = DE_total,
                edited_genes = DE_edited,
                edited_fraction = DE_edited_fraction
            )
        ]
    ),
    use.names = TRUE
)


# P value is attached only to the DE bar.
if (plot_p_mode == "two_sided") {
    DE_p_df <- DE_all[
        ,
        .(
            sex,
            editing_definition,
            group = "DE",
            plot_p = fisher_p_two_sided_BH
        )
    ]
} else {
    DE_p_df <- DE_all[
        ,
        .(
            sex,
            editing_definition,
            group = "DE",
            plot_p = fisher_p_enrichment_BH
        )
    ]
}


DE_plot_df <- merge(
    DE_plot_df,
    DE_p_df,
    by = c(
        "sex",
        "editing_definition",
        "group"
    ),
    all.x = TRUE,
    sort = FALSE
)


DE_plot_df[
    ,
    edited_percent :=
        100 * edited_fraction
]


DE_plot_df[
    ,
    n_label :=
        paste0(
            edited_genes,
            "/",
            total_genes
        )
]


DE_plot_df[
    ,
    p_label :=
        vapply(
            plot_p,
            format_plot_p,
            character(1)
        )
]


DE_plot_df[
    ,
    bar_label :=
        ifelse(
            p_label == "",
            n_label,
            paste0(
                n_label,
                "\n",
                p_label
            )
        )
]


DE_plot_df[
    ,
    group_plot := factor(
        group,
        levels = c(
            "No_DE",
            "DE"
        ),
        labels = c(
            "No-DE",
            "DE"
        )
    )
]


DE_plot_df[
    ,
    editing_definition_plot := factor(
        editing_definition,
        levels = editing_definition_levels,
        labels = editing_definition_labels
    )
]


DE_plot_df[
    ,
    sex_plot := factor(
        sex,
        levels = sex_levels,
        labels = sex_labels
    )
]


fwrite(
    DE_plot_df,
    file.path(
        out_dir,
        "PLOT_DATA.DE_vs_NoDE.grouped_bar.tsv"
    ),
    sep = "\t"
)


p_DE <- ggplot(

    )
) +
    geom_col(

    geom_text(
        aes(

    ) +

        ),

            size = 11
        ),
        plot.title = element_text(
            face = "bold",
            size = 13
        ),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(
            size = 9
        )
    )


ggsave(

)

cluster_plot_df <- copy(

# ------------------------------------------------------------

if (plot_p_mode == "two_sided") {

} else {

        .(
            sex,
            editing_definition,
            group,
            plot_p = fisher_p_enrichment_BH
        )
    ]
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Merge P onto the corresponding cluster bar.
# No-DE has no P because it is the reference group.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cluster_plot_df <- merge(
    cluster_plot_df,
    cluster_p_df,
    by = c(
        "sex",
        "editing_definition",
        "group"
    ),
    all.x = TRUE,
    sort = FALSE
)


cluster_plot_df[
    ,
    edited_percent :=
        100 * edited_fraction
]


cluster_plot_df[

        )

cluster_plot_df[

        )
]


cluster_plot_df[
    ,
    bar_label :=
        ifelse(
            group == "No_DE",
            n_label,
            paste0(
                n_label,
                "\n",
                p_label
            )
        )
]


# ------------------------------------------------------------

cluster_names_plot <- unique(

cluster_numbers_plot <- as.integer(
    sub(
        "^Cluster",

cluster_names_plot <- cluster_names_plot[

    )

group_levels_plot <- c(
    "No_DE",

)

group_labels_plot <- c(
```
